title: MUSCLE MANGA - Baki Hanma's Physique in Grappler Baki (part. 1)
summary: NH analyses 13-year-old Baki's original physique and character before the Yasha Ape arc: a small frame with developed legs, V-taper, abs and an upper back that outpaces the rest. He discusses Baki's upbringing and his shift from fighting purely for progression to fighting for love of it.
claims: Baki's young physique shows developed legs, smaller arms and upper body, capped shoulders and a V-taper
A small frame is a genetic trait that defines how a physique looks
Core rigidity and leg power show up visually in a well-developed six-pack and obliques
Punching patterns resemble horizontal pulls, which develop the mid and lower traps and upper back
In natural bodybuilders the posterior chain and upper back tend to develop last; they're 'mature muscles'
NH played Pokemon at Baki's age
